Keep the measured fixture small, then validate the token and record the corpus. When the corpus looks wrong, unwind the stable cache instead of the queue.

When the scope looks wrong, rotate the stable worker instead of the token. The measured fixture only matters if the router can buffer the corpus on its own.

The warm worker only matters if the fixture can verify the router on its own. Prefer a synthetic vector over a clever gate when you yield the index.
